Key Takeaways
The meeting aimed to demonstrate a WhatsApp ordering system for automating customer orders to reduce manual workload.
Attendees included Vijay, the presenter, and potential clients Sagnik, Suresh, and Tuan, who were evaluating the solution.
Key points discussed were integration with Shopify/WooCommerce, cost structure, customization options, and current limitations with manual order processing.
Follow-up actions included sending a proposal with detailed pricing and custom options, along with scheduling a future discussion for feedback.
The clients expressed interest in the solution, requesting a detailed proposal and considering a two-day timeline for implementation.
